_doc: Koi Blossom engine trial (tag koi), re-run 2026-10-20 after the founder ruling: the GARMENT MOCKUP governs, close-ups only inform. Gates read the MOCKUP-ONLY reference (registration_mockup.json, closeup null: no feather mask, every tile judged against mockup pixels, ~0.9 px/mm source detail). Garment mm on the FR piece (wearer's right front), size M: x from CF (+ = wearer's left, FR is x < 0), y from the CF neck seam. Crop kept from the first trial (x -220..-50, y 30..300): it holds the mockup's upper lily, the dark lower flower, leaves, the vine, floating petals and 4 mockup fish (a 5th at the right edge). The delivered Rev B FR file is scored on exactly this crop (baseline_dst: a git-ignored copy in out/revB/, origin aligned on the Rev C build's recorded origin, bench/TRIAL.md).
name: koi-fr-m
